cards.title: Moss Message Observatory Story Goal Path Card
cards.goalSkill: connect a fictional want, snag, first try, rethink, finish note, and pocket label for one moss message observatory page
cards.useCase: Adult-led fictional offline paper-only pocket folder goal path card for one moss message observatory page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out one pocket folder, a blank page, a pencil, and a pocket label slip before the goal path begins: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: invent an observatory helper who reads pretend moss messages and keeps every goal path note on paper: ____________________.
cards.wantPrompt: Want: write what the observatory helper wants to learn from the pretend moss message today: ____________________.
cards.snagPrompt: Snag: name one small paper snag that makes the moss message hard to understand at first: ____________________.
cards.firstTryPrompt: First try: write the first calm paper plan the helper tries to follow the moss message: ____________________.
cards.rethinkPrompt: Rethink: choose what the helper notices after the snag and how the paper plan changes: ____________________.
cards.finishNotePrompt: Finish note: write the final note that shows what the helper understands now: ____________________.
cards.pocketLabelPrompt: Pocket label: write the short pretend label for this moss message goal path: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult points to the want blank, and the writer fills only the finish note line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: tuck the moss message page into the pocket folder with one goal path note to continue later: ____________________.

cards.title: Rain Gauge Railway Story Goal Path Card
cards.goalSkill: build a fictional railway goal path with a want, snag, first try, rethink, finish note, and pocket label
cards.useCase: Adult-led fictional offline paper-only pocket folder goal path card for one rain gauge railway page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place one pocket folder beside a blank rail note, a pencil, and a pocket label strip for the goal path: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: make up a railway helper, a pretend gauge mark, and a paper-only goal path with no real trip details: ____________________.
cards.wantPrompt: Want: write what the railway helper wants the pretend gauge mark to help with: ____________________.
cards.snagPrompt: Snag: name the small paper snag that makes the gauge mark point to the wrong rail note at first: ____________________.
cards.firstTryPrompt: First try: write the first paper step the helper tries to sort the gauge mark: ____________________.
cards.rethinkPrompt: Rethink: choose the new rail note the helper checks after the first try does not work: ____________________.
cards.finishNotePrompt: Finish note: write how the helper connects the gauge mark to a clearer paper ending: ____________________.
cards.pocketLabelPrompt: Pocket label: write the short pretend label for this railway goal path: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult names the gauge mark, and the writer fills only the rethink blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep the rail note in the pocket folder with one want, snag, or first try line to finish later: ____________________.

cards.title: Pond Bridge Blueprint Club Story Goal Path Card

cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out one pocket folder, a blank blueprint page, a pencil, and a pocket label slip for the goal path: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: invent a blueprint club helper and plan a pretend pond bridge idea only on paper: ____________________.
cards.wantPrompt: Want: write what the blueprint helper wants the pretend pond bridge to help connect: ____________________.
cards.snagPrompt: Snag: name one small blueprint snag, such as a line that points to the wrong page corner: ____________________.
cards.firstTryPrompt: First try: write the first paper plan the helper sketches to fix the bridge idea: ____________________.
cards.rethinkPrompt: Rethink: choose what the helper notices on the blueprint and how the plan changes: ____________________.
cards.finishNotePrompt: Finish note: write the final paper note that explains the new bridge idea: ____________________.
cards.pocketLabelPrompt: Pocket label: write the short pretend label for this blueprint club goal path: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult circles the snag blank, and the writer fills only one first try phrase: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: slide the blueprint page into the pocket folder with the pocket label ready for another paper plan: ____________________.

cards.title: Chapter Gate Greenhouse Story Goal Path Card
cards.goalSkill: plan a longer fictional greenhouse goal path with want, snag, first try, rethink, finish note, and pocket label
cards.useCase: Adult-led fictional offline paper-only pocket folder goal path card for one chapter gate greenhouse page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set one pocket folder, a blank greenhouse page, a pencil, and a pocket label slip beside the goal path prompt: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: invent a greenhouse gate helper and write a paper-only goal path with made-up details: ____________________.
cards.wantPrompt: Want: write what the greenhouse gate helper wants to open, sort, or understand on the pretend page: ____________________.
cards.snagPrompt: Snag: name one small gate snag that keeps the helper from moving the goal path forward at first: ____________________.
cards.firstTryPrompt: First try: write the first thoughtful paper plan the helper tries at the chapter gate greenhouse: ____________________.
cards.rethinkPrompt: Rethink: choose what the helper learns from the snag and what changes in the next paper plan: ____________________.
cards.finishNotePrompt: Finish note: write the final note that shows how the helper reached a calm stopping point: ____________________.
cards.pocketLabelPrompt: Pocket label: write the short pretend label for this greenhouse goal path: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult points to the first try blank, and the writer fills only the rethink line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: tuck the greenhouse page into the pocket folder with the finish note facing up for later use: ____________________.
